results.title: Grey Zone Guest Paper Series | Denying Strategic Gains: South Korea’s Conditional Proactive Response to North Korean Grey-Zone Coercion - HCSS
results.snippet:
The Korean case offers important lessons for European small and middle powers facing Russian coercion. It demonstrates that nuclear capabilities create a delicate balance between deterrence and escalation control. South Korea also demonstrates that states must show that sub-threshold aggression yields no strategic advantages, without themselves opening the door to a wider conflict.
